statements.subject: server
statements.description: The request MUST NOT be issued unless the server is in the Play state.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The Request-Status header (Section 18.42) MUST be included to indicate which request the notification is for and its completion status.
actions: include Request-Status header in PLAY_NOTIFY end-of-stream request

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The sender of a PLAY_NOTIFY MAY issue an updated PLAY_NOTIFY, in the case of a PLAY_NOTIFY sent with wrong information.
actions: send updated PLAY_NOTIFY with corrected information

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In this case, a new PLAY_NOTIFY MUST be sent including the correct status for the completion and all additional information.
actions: send new PLAY_NOTIFY with correct completion status and all additional information

statements.subject: message
statements.description: PLAY_NOTIFY requests with the Notify-Reason header set to end-of-stream MUST include a Range header and the Scale header if the scale value is not 1.
actions: include Range header in PLAY_NOTIFY end-of-stream request
include Scale header in PLAY_NOTIFY end-of-stream request if scale value is not 1

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST NOT use the "now" constant in the Range header; it MUST use the actual numeric end position in the proper timescale.
actions: do not use "now" constant in the Range header of PLAY_NOTIFY end-of-stream request

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST NOT use the "now" constant in the Range header; it MUST use the actual numeric end position in the proper timescale.
actions: set Range header to actual numeric end position in the proper timescale in PLAY_NOTIFY end-of-stream request

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If RTP is used as media transport, an RTP-Info header MUST be included, and the RTP-Info header MUST indicate the last sequence number in the sequence parameter.
actions: include RTP-Info header in PLAY_NOTIFY end-of-stream request

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If RTP is used as media transport, an RTP-Info header MUST be included, and the RTP-Info header MUST indicate the last sequence number in the sequence parameter.
actions: set RTP-Info sequence parameter to last sequence number in PLAY_NOTIFY end-of-stream request

statements.subject: session
statements.description: In those cases, an RTSP session under aggregated control SHOULD send only a single PLAY_NOTIFY request.
statements.pre_cond: server.state = Play & session.aggregated_control = true & resources.end_time_difference = small
actions: send single PLAY_NOTIFY using aggregate control URI for all media resources

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In cases where one or more media resources have a significantly shorter duration than some other resources in the aggregated session, the server MAY send end-of-stream notifications using individual media resource URIs to indicate to agents that there will be no more media for this particular media resource related to the current active PLAY request.
statements.pre_cond: server.state = Play & session.aggregated_control = true & resource.duration << other_resources.duration
actions: send PLAY_NOTIFY end-of-stream notification using individual media resource URI for short-duration resource

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In such cases, when the remaining media resources come to the end of the stream, they MUST send a PLAY_NOTIFY request using the aggregate control URI to indicate that no more resources remain.
actions: send PLAY_NOTIFY end-of-stream request using aggregate control URI when all remaining resources end

statements.subject: message
statements.description: A PLAY_NOTIFY request with Notify-Reason header set to end-of-stream MUST NOT carry a message body.
actions: omit message body from PLAY_NOTIFY end-of-stream request
